hooks.text: 玩家围绕圣杯神殿的环形道路循环前进，从 200 多种地块中决定路径内容，每圈敌人都会增强。
hooks.excerpt: Travel along the ring-shaped road around the Grail Temple. You decide what awaits on your path, with over 200 tiles offering unique effects. With each lap, enemies grow stronger, encouraging you to evolve your strategies and discover new combinations and rewards.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 采集森林与山地资源后建设堡垒、招募军队、摧毁敌方据点，并寻找建筑地块联动。
hooks.excerpt: Gather resources from forests and mountains, build fortresses to recruit troops, destroy enemy strongholds, discover powerful tile combinations, and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡牌用于放置道路地块，商店只出售牌组内卡牌，并在每圈加入一张随机牌改变后续循环。
hooks.excerpt: You’ll need cards to place tiles. Cards can be earned in battle or purchased with gold. Shops only offer cards from your deck, and each lap, you can add one random card.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
